evals.prompt: What skills are available to install?
evals.expected_output: Invokes list-skills.py script. Presents numbered list of curated skills from openai/skills repo. Annotes already-installed skills. Asks user which ones to install. Does NOT manually fetch GitHub API.

Uses install-skill-from-github.py with --repo openai/skills --path skills/.curated/powershell-master. Installs to ~/.agents/skills/powershell-master. Tells user to restart agent after install. Does NOT manually clone or download.

Uses install-skill-from-github.py with --url argument. Parses owner/repo/ref/path from URL. Installs to ~/.agents/skills/my-skill. Handles auth via GITHUB_TOKEN if needed. Falls back to git sparse checkout on download failure.
Invokes list-skills.py with --path skills/.experimental. Labels source as experimental. Lists skills with installed annotations. Does not confuse with curated list.

evals.prompt: Install a skill from a private GitHub repository.
evals.expected_output: Uses install-skill-from-github.py with --repo and --path. Mentions GITHUB_TOKEN or GH_TOKEN for authentication. Explains git fallback (HTTPS then SSH) if download fails. Does not hardcode tokens.
Script aborts with 'Destination already exists' error. Agent reports the error to the user and explains the skill is already installed. Does NOT attempt to overwrite or force install.

evals.prompt: Install the system skill for code review.
evals.expected_output: Agent explains that system skills (skills/.system) are preinstalled and do not need installation. Does NOT attempt to install from skills/.system. If user insists, explains overwrite is possible but unnecessary.

evals.prompt: What skills are available to install? The GitHub API is returning a 500 error.
evals.expected_output: Script fails with HTTP error. Agent explains the error to the user and exits gracefully. Does NOT retry silently or fabricate a skills list. Suggests trying again later or checking GitHub status.
